manifest.name: dsh-plugin-tetris
manifest.description: Play Tetris in the DSH Web GUI while the agent is working

bundle.text:
# Bundle patch layer for dsh-plugin-tetris.
#
# Applied when this package is listed in the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`
# (`dsh plugin --profile web add link:<path>` appends it automatically), or when
# the same `insert` row is added to the profile's own cordis.patch.yml.
#
# A `dsh.client` row is what the client-modules node half scans into the
# browser roster, so this single row is all it takes to get the plugin into
# window.__DSH_BOOT__ and served from /plugins/dsh-plugin-tetris/client.js.
- insert:
    - id: tetris
      name: 'dsh-plugin-tetris'

readme.text: **趁 agent 干活的时候，在 DSH Web GUI 里来一局俄罗斯方块。** [中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-tetris) [](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) | 模式菜单 | 对局 | |:---:|:---:| | | |

用 DSH 写代码的时候，等 agent 跑任务总有几十秒空档，于是把它做成了一个插件：
游戏面板挂在 DSH 的框架级浮动层上，agent 开始工作时自动出现；右下角常驻一个圆形
T 形方块图标，随时点开就能玩，面板会从图标的位置弹出。

引擎不是随手写的——它是我另一个项目
[**tetris-terminal**](https://github.com/zlh124/tetris-terminal)（Python 终端版俄罗斯方块）
的逐行 TypeScript 移植：7-bag、SRS 墙踢、Hold、Ghost、T-Spin、B2B、消行动画都和终端版一致，
连终端版的一些怪癖也一并保留了。规则和手感是它先做出来的。

> 觉得好玩的话，去给 [**tetris-terminal**](https://github.com/zlh124/tetris-terminal) 点个 ⭐ 吧。

| 键 | 动作 |
|---|---|
| `←` `→` / `A` `D` | 左右移动 |
| `↑` / `W` / `X` | 顺时针旋转 |
| `Z` | 逆时针旋转 |
| `↓` / `S` | 软降 |
| `空格` | 硬降 |
| `C` | Hold |
| `P` | 暂停 / 继续 |

先点一下棋盘再用键盘；聚焦后棋盘会有一圈绿色描边。标题栏的「焦点联动」滑块控制
"失焦自动暂停 + 对话结束把焦点交还游戏"。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-tetris
```

装完不需要刷新页面。卸载：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-tetris
```

从源码开发：`npm install && npm run build`，然后
`dsh plugin --profile web add link:"$PWD"`。

> 仓库里提交了构建产物 `lib/`，所以也可以直接从 git 装：
> `dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/<you>/dsh-plugin-tetris.git`。

**Play a round of Tetris in the DSH Web GUI while the agent is working.** [中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-tetris) [](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) | Mode menu | Playing | |:---:|:---:| | | |

While coding with DSH, waiting for the agent to finish leaves you with a few dozen idle
seconds — so this became a plugin. The game panel lives in DSH's frame-level overlay and
appears on its own when the agent starts working. A circular T-tetrimino icon stays in the
bottom-right corner, and the panel opens right where that icon sits.

The engine is not a throwaway: it is a line-by-line TypeScript port of my other project
[**tetris-terminal**](https://github.com/zlh124/tetris-terminal) (a Python terminal Tetris).
7-bag, SRS wall kicks, Hold, Ghost, T-Spin, Back-to-Back and the line-clear animation all
match the terminal version, quirks included. The rules and feel came from there first.

> If you enjoy this, go give [**tetris-terminal**](https://github.com/zlh124/tetris-terminal) a ⭐.

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| `←` `→` / `A` `D` | Move left / right |
| `↑` / `W` / `X` | Rotate clockwise |
| `Z` | Rotate counter-clockwise |
| `↓` / `S` | Soft drop |
| `Space` | Hard drop |
| `C` | Hold |
| `P` | Pause / resume |

Click the board once before using the keyboard; a green ring shows it has focus. The
"焦点联动" slider in the title bar toggles *pause on blur* and *focus returns when the
conversation ends*.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-tetris
```

No page refresh needed. Uninstall:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-tetris
```

Working from source: `npm install && npm run build`, then
`dsh plugin --profile web add link:"$PWD"`.

> The built `lib/` is committed, so a git install works too:
> `dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/<you>/dsh-plugin-tetris.git`.

MIT. The engine logic comes from [tetris-terminal](https://github.com/zlh124/tetris-terminal)
(MIT, jayzhu).
